chapter: Childhood, Mardi Gras and first brass band
title: Mardi Gras Indians in the old days
summary: He remembers the Pocahontas Indians dancing in the street and meeting at Claiborne.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Yeah. I was wondering about the Indian dances those days. See, they still have the Indians in this part of town more around Galvez and Conti over in that section or even Claiborne. They sort of do this chanting and singing along with it. Do you remember any of those Indians in the old days? What the, the regular Indian clubs or whatever they call them? Well, I... Did that go way back when you were a boy? Do you remember?
Well, I remember the Pocahontas was one. Yeah.
Did they do any special dancing or music with it in those days? Any like drums or anything with them or?
No, they just go, go to the street dancing and put on Indian dance. Yeah. There was a bunch, there was a group used to meet at Bourbon, at, well it was Bourbon at that time but now it's Polga.
Polga and Claiborne. Used to meet there.
